purpose: Full POI + Territorial Knowledge regression baseline. Not loaded by the app.
principles: Every HIRUNDU POI has a knowledge record.
Uncertain inherited POI labels are marked legacy-pending rather than silently corrected or hallucinated.
Every POI may be linked to one or more territories through territoryIds.
A full POI name takes precedence over a territory name.
Territory context is remembered for conversational follow-ups.
Territory POI lists can be filtered by theme or knowledge aspect.
Exact route execution remains POI-based and unchanged.
